digest:
Product: cc-smith, for credit-card holders in India. Hackathon build for the SerpApi India Hackathon 2026 (Commerce & Market Intelligence), submission 10 Oct 2026 18:00 IST.

Facts: 22 cards in the catalogue, profiled from official bank pages (allow-list in docs/research/official-domains.yaml). A card fact is published only if (1) its URL is official for that field (bank for fees/earn/caps; co-brand partner for its reward currency; fintech operators like Kiwi and Scapia also for earn rules), (2) the verbatim quote is found in the fetched page or PDF, (3) every rupee amount, cap and percentage appears in its own quote, (4) range checks pass (earn ≤25%, fee ≤₹1 lakh). Otherwise it is speculation: shown as 'reported, not confirmed by the bank', never used in maths. No human review; every change alerts the owner. 21 merchant offers and 4 fee offers (LTF/FYF/joining waiver) from bank pages; one distributor copy is speculation. Money is integer paise. Fees include 18% GST.

A quick model (Haiku 4.5, 2.5 s limit, median 1.5 s measured) chooses the card at checkout from engine-computed figures and never calculates; rupee amounts in its reason must be supplied figures; timeout, error or invalid answer falls back to the engine's pick (decision D10). Checkout's engine pick is the best card for the month: this payment plus what the rest of the month still earns after it (spends prorated to the days left, under remaining caps and credit); ties go to the narrower rule, keeping broad caps like SBI Cashback's 5% on all online free. Engine: per purchase, rules matched by merchant > category > catch-all, then rule priority; exclusions; minimum amount; caps per period from the ledger; stacked bonus rules; UPI only for RuPay cards; memberships (Amazon Prime, Tata NeuPass, Kiwi Neon, paying bills through Google Pay) gate some rules. Finder simulates a year month by month, routing each spend to the best card, then hill-climbs whole-line moves so fee waivers and milestones are kept; adding a card can never score below the current stack minus its fee.

Decisions (owner): no affiliate money; no human in the loop (DR-12); hackathon first; Android only through M3; category spend amount is the total and merchants are part of it; per-card memberships; held cards can be LTF or FYF; shared credit pools; available credit = limit − (entered outstanding + logged payments − bills paid); notice board with reasons; payment capture manual until statement upload (M1) and notification/Gmail capture (M2); credit score is a user-entered band (no bureau API).

Open: premium tier undecided. Known gaps: report-wrong-info does not trigger a re-fetch although its response says so; score band not asked in onboarding; offer estimates take 'up to' figures at face value; fee-offer eligibility conditions are not checked against the user; Scapia Axis is treated as the Scapia Federal card; Airtel Axis 25%/10% rules not modelled; four cards listed but not scored (SimplyCLICK, Coral, AU LIT, Scapia). Live since 10 Oct: SerpApi key (22 searches used, 228 of 250 left) and Anthropic key; checkout model median 1.5 s with a 2.5 s limit; extraction runs live without strict mode; the first live Launch Radar sweep found 12 reported launches, with duplicates from headline wording.
